title: Forever Young
scene: 1984 West German synth-pop and New Romantic; Studio 54 Berlin
sounds_like: Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark|Ultravox|Roxy Music|Kraftwerk
notes: Cold sequencers and dramatic vocals frame atomic anxiety, romantic longing and bright dance-pop.

title: Afternoons in Utopia
scene: 1986 Berlin–New York synth-pop with studio session band, brass and choir
sounds_like: Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark|The Associates|Ultravox
notes: Expansive science-fiction pop layers synthesizers, choirs, brass and guitar around richly arranged songs.

title: The Breathtaking Blue
scene: 1989 Berlin electronic pop with Klaus Schulze and acoustic chamber/jazz textures
sounds_like: Talk Talk (The Colour of Spring)|The Blue Nile|Tangerine Dream
notes: Schulze-produced synth-pop expands into guitars, acoustic bass, saxophone and lush strings.

title: Prostitute
scene: 1994 Berlin studio electronic pop, crossover guitar music and trance experiments
sounds_like: Depeche Mode (Songs of Faith and Devotion)|Peter Gabriel (Us)|The Blue Nile
notes: Dark, exploratory electronic pop mixes rock guitars, programmed textures, strings and sprawling introspection.
